## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-1 certifies only quotient ranks and torsion; these invariants do not determine the \(G_L\)-to-\(G_R\) transition matrices.
- claim-2 is explicitly provisional and lacks a valid degree-\(10\) block, quotient-coordinate witnesses, and determinant/Smith verification.
- No dominance-unitriangularity test is supplied with explicit row/column dominance orders and sign conventions.
- Although the draft correctly states that the target was not established, it does not complete the requested computation.

## Unresolved certificates
- [computation] Using artifact `621a26ec7b4419d76351b43e22fff9df644945c6458e2a531d2542a0819b6602`, reconstruct exact quotient coordinates for the ordered \(G_L\) and \(G_R\) elements in degrees \(6,\ldots,10\); output every transition block under \([g_{L,r}]=\sum_c(T_d)_{r,c}[g_{R,c}]\), certify each by determinant or Smith data, and test dominance-unitriangularity under explicitly stated orders.
